description: The same payment sent two to four ways (a bank wire, a payment provider, a stablecoin route through an on-ramp and an off-ramp), each measured end to end against one independent reference: what left, what landed, each route's cost with a margin of error, and the exact gap between them. The rail does not change the method. Free within the daily allowance.

annualVolume.description: Optional yearly volume on this route in the from currency, to state the gap per year.

date.description: Optional payment date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (a quote).

from.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency that left, e.g. 'ZAR'.

routes.description: Two to four routes. Each: label, landed (in the to currency), and optionally sent and fee (both in the from currency).

fee.description: Optional. Fees charged on top for this route, in the from currency.

label.description: Your name for this route, e.g. 'Bank wire' or 'USDC via ramp'.

landed.description: Amount this route landed, in the to currency, after every deduction.

sent.description: Optional. Amount this route sent, in the from currency; defaults to the shared sent.
Optional amount sent, shared by every route that does not state its own.

to.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency that landed, e.g. 'KES'.

name: swapeazi_route_compare
title: Bank or stablecoin: compare routes
